name: match-progress
title: MatchProgress
description: feedback: Progress bar drawn as a row of matches, each catching from the last as the job advances (canvas 2D, server-safe bar, reduced motion -> still)

item.name: match-progress
item.summary: feedback: Progress bar drawn as a row of matches, each catching from the last as the job advances (canvas 2D, server-safe bar, reduced motion -> still)

useWhen: A job with real progress the visitor waits for (an upload, a build, an import)
A hero or onboarding step where progress is the moment
avoidWhen: Indeterminate waits with no real percentage
Many progress bars in a table

tiers.0: One still frame on the canvas (reduced motion, Save-Data, no WebGL2), redrawn only when the value changes
tiers.2: Animated at DPR <= 1.5 with half the particles
tiers.3: Animated at DPR <= 2 with the full particle count

reducedMotion.description: The reached matches stand lit with a steady glow; no flame, no sparks, no burning down. One frame per change.

a11y.notes: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow/min/max and a required accessible name; the visible percentage is its text. The canvas is aria-hidden; before it mounts a plain bar shows the same value. Each burn lasts 7 s and stops.

props.name: value
props.effect: Required. Progress 0-100; each match catches as the value passes its share.

props.name: label
props.effect: Required. Accessible name of the progress bar.

props.name: matches
props.effect: Number of matches in the row.

props.name: showValue
props.effect: Show the percentage under the row.

props.name: palette
props.effect: Colours of the effect (DESIGN.md A8). custom reads --fb-heat-0..4 from the page.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop: the effect stops drawing; the control keeps working.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on the capability tier.

props.name: nonce
props.effect: CSP nonce for the component's <style> element.

props.name: style
props.effect: Inline styles on the root, merged after the palette variables.

mistakes: Pass real progress (0-100). For an unknown wait, use the host's spinner instead.
label is required: it names the progress bar.
Leave about 150 px of height for the standing matches.
verify: Server HTML has a progressbar with aria-valuenow and a plain bar.
Raising value lights matches in order with a burst.
Burning stops within 7 s and the loop goes quiet.
